title: Preserve original 830th applied provider migration and synchronize original source lock before downstream release
root_cause: Original protected #5652 Supabase migration 20261112162500_original_metric_source_temporal_handoff_v1 was applied to production, while original checked-in migration-history.lock.json remained at provider-backed 829 rather than 830, repeating drift immediately after protected SQL merges.
impact: Other protected website/Portal/Powerhouse releases can fail source/provider migration parity even though the backend migration was actually applied. Do not reapply executed SQL or conceal drift.
fix: Source-only append of exact provider-confirmed version and name to original immutable migration-history.lock.json, preserving the earlier 829 records. Update original Continuity skill with source→consumer processed-ACK prevention; protected CI, independent provider readback, no new worker or DDL.
prevention_rule: The original Supabase migration writer must hand off the exact applied provider version/name/readback to the original checked-in lock writer before declaring a dependent protected release ready; retain idempotent same-provider lineage and fail closed if the consumer has not acknowledged lock parity.
owner: Original Supabase migration history writer / ONE BRAIN backend owner
